data.body:
PLAN REVIEW #1 (at HEAD e1566b5f4): BLOCK, 4 findings. All four were REAL defects in the plan, not
gate noise. Remediated:

1. COH/E1 — SELF-CONTRADICTING AC. AC7 demanded docs/env-vars.md 'regenerates with no diff', while the
   Approach introduces NINE new env vars (REBAR_LLM_{FRONTIER,STANDARD,TRIVIAL}_{MODEL,PROVIDER,
   ENDPOINT}) that necessarily appear in the generator's output — and Scope named only config.py and
   tests/. The AC could not be satisfied by a correct implementation. Scope now names docs/env-vars.md
   as a deliverable, and the AC now says the file is REGENERATED AND COMMITTED here, lists the nine
   vars, and THEN re-running the generator is a no-op — which is what the drift gate actually checks.

2. E4 — I DESCRIBED UNBUILT WORK AS SHIPPED. The plan said an environment needing a fallback chain
   uses REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE 'which exists for exactly this'. It does not exist anywhere in src/ or
   docs/ — it is sibling task cb6f's deliverable. Present tense for a sibling's unlanded work is a
   trap for an executor who would go looking for it. Now stated explicitly as NOT existing yet, with
   the consequence spelled out: until cb6f lands there is no environment-only way to set a fallback
   chain, and that is accepted because this ticket's job is the SCHEMA, not the delivery mechanism.

3+4. T8/E2 — THE FALLBACK SUB-OBJECT SCHEMA WAS NEVER DEFINED. 'An array of sub-objects' is not a
   spec; nobody could write the parser or a test against it. Now a decided table: a fallback entry is
   a provider target with exactly a class slot's fields MINUS fallback — model (required), provider
   (optional -> infer_provider), endpoint (optional), api_key FORBIDDEN.

   DECIDED: it is NON-RECURSIVE. An entry carrying its own fallback key is a typed config error. The
   chain is already an ordered list, so nesting adds no expressiveness while introducing cycle risk
   and unbounded resolution depth. Also pinned: fallback = [] and an absent fallback key are the SAME
   thing (no fallbacks), so the empty-array case cannot be read two ways.

Four ACs added, each falsifiable: api_key rejected on an ENTRY (not just a slot), nested fallback
rejected, entry-level provider inference matching slot behaviour, and the corrected doc-regeneration
criterion. Re-review running.
